cards.title: Hidden Power
cards.instruction: Act publicly modest while making choices as though you control the outcome.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: It's only a little dog-sitting. Yes, bring him over after his walk; I'll decide where his bed goes while your kitchen's being repaired.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He needs to stay overnight too.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Absolutely. I'll put you in the guest room beside him, so you can give him breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can stay, but his six o'clock walk is your job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I'll organise it: lead by the door, your alarm at five thirty. I'll put your shoes out too, so you won't have to plan a thing.
